title: Application of Metaheuristics in Feature Selection for IoT Networks
content: Employing metaheuristics to optimize feature selection in IoT networks targets enhancements in system efficiency, security, and energy management. A survey of research from the Scopus database highlighted intrusion detection as a heavily investigated domain. By merging metaheuristics with machine learning approaches, advancements have been made in threat detection accuracy, energy consumption optimization, and cybersecurity enhancement. Continued exploration into adaptive algorithms and preprocessing techniques is advised to tackle computational challenges and unstructured data management.
